lines.trans: Eduard Valentinovich, what is going on here?
Why are you mistreating our staff?
Their salaries went toward your project.
Then there will be no project!
I completely drop it.
Wait! What do you mean you drop it?
You must do this project!
I owe nothing to other people!
Wait! Otherwise they will simply kill me!
Who will kill you? Are you joking?
They beat me literally every day!
Two huge and scary men!
These are your problems, not mine.
I will not work for someone else's money.

meanings.en: to beat, to hit, to strike

examples.text: Почему меня все бьют в этом доме?
examples.trans: Why does everyone beat me in this house?
They beat me literally every day!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
жить на зарплату = to live on one's salary
verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
